parameters.text:
=Analyze the meeting transcript provided as input. Return a concise meeting summary, all action items, the person responsible for each, deadlines, and a professional follow-up email. If an owner or deadline isn't mentioned, write "not specified." Don't change the AI model yet.{{ $json.meeting_transcript }}
ADDITIONAL TOOL INSTRUCTIONS:

1. GOOGLE TASKS:
Use the Google Tasks tool to create a separate task
for each action item identified in the meeting transcript.
Use the action item as the task title.
Include the responsible person's name when specified.
Set the due date when a deadline is provided.
Do not invent missing deadlines.
2. GOOGLE CALENDAR:
Use the Google Calendar tool to create a calendar event
when the transcript specifies a follow-up meeting with
a clear date and start time.
Use the meeting details provided in the transcript.
Do not invent a date or start time.
If essential meeting details are missing, ask for clarification.
3. GMAIL:
Generate a professional follow-up email containing the
meeting summary, action items, responsible persons,
and deadlines.
If a valid recipient email address is provided in the
input, use the Gmail tool to send the email.
Never invent a recipient email address.
If no recipient email address is provided, ask the user
for one instead.
4. FINAL RESPONSE:
Return the meeting summary, action items, responsible
persons, deadlines, and follow-up email.
Report whether Google Tasks, Google Calendar, and Gmail
successfully completed their operations.
Never claim an operation succeeded unless the tool confirms it.
IMPORTANT: Actually call the connected tools when their
conditions are met. Do not merely describe what they would do.
